items.w: הקשיבה רנתי האזינה תפלתי בלא שפתי מרמה
items.title: SINCERITY
items.quote: Hashem, hear [my] sincere [thoughts]; be attentive to my song; listen to my tefillah [that is] not from lips of deception.
items.text: Be honest and sincere whenever you speak, but especially when addressing Hashem. If you are not totally open with Him, he knows it.

items.w: צרפתני בל תמצא זמתי בל יעבר פי
items.text: , “You have tested me and found no [hypocrisy]; my thoughts did not contradict the words of my mouth.”

items.title: BAD INFLUENCES
items.quote: I have guarded against the ways of the offender.
items.text: Avoid interacting with people who do not observe the mitzvos.

items.w: תמך אשרי במעגלותיך בל נמוטו פעמי
items.title: HELP WITH MITZVOS
items.quote: Support my steps in Your pathways so that my feet do not trip.
items.text: Ask Hashem to help you in your desire to observe His mitzvos. Make the case that you do not want to fail Him because of your weaknesses.

items.title: CONFIDENCE
items.quote: I call to You because You will answer me.
items.text: If you have done teshuvah, be confident in approaching Hashem to hear your tefillos.

items.title: DIVINE PRESENCE
items.quote: Shelter me in the shadow of Your wings.
items.text: Ask Hashem to let your enemies fear to attack you because they sense His watchful presence.

items.w: מפני רשעים זו שדוני איבי בנפש יקיפו עלי
items.title: SHELTER
items.quote: [Shelter me] from those resha’im who rob me, my mortal enemies who encircle me.
items.text: Ask Hashem to protect you from evil men who are seeking to cause you harm.

items.title: LUXURIES
items.quote: They have covered [their heart] with their fat; their mouths speak with arrogance.
items.text: Avoid indulging in conspicuous luxuries. Such behavior breeds arrogance and makes you feel that you have no need to seek sustenance from Your Creator.

items.title: DELAYED ATTACK
items.quote: Rescue my soul from the rasha, [acting as] Your sword.
items.text: Ask Hashem to stop the rasha who is out to harm you. Ask that his attack be delayed to give you the opportunity to do teshuvah.

items.title: NATURAL DEATH
items.quote: Hashem, [let me be] from among those who die by Your hand, who die of old age.
items.text: Ask Hashem that when it is time for you to leave this world it will be a natural death and that you will not be the victim of violence.

items.w: אני בצדק אחזה פניך אשבעה בהקיץ תמונתך
items.title: ETERNAL LIFE
items.quote: For [my] righteousness let me behold Your face. Upon awakening [in the World to Come] I will be gratified [to behold] Your image.
items.text: Ask Hashem to grant you the privilege of life in the World to come.
